sources.title: Beijing University of Chemical Technology 2026 international undergraduate programs

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid ordinary private passport and agree to observe Chinese laws and BUCT regulations.
Be a high-school graduate or above, qualified to apply to university, and normally age 18-25.
Meet the nationality and residence rules in Ministry of Education Document No. 12 [2020].
Submit notarized guardianship records for a guardian holding Beijing residency.
Complete the application by June 30, 2026.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Submit CSCA scores for the official route-table subjects: Mathematics, Chemistry. Chinese-medium applicants must also pass CSCA Professional Chinese.

references.locator: Program table CSCA designated elective column and language table

requirements.ruleText: Submit the BUCT curriculum-vitae and study-proposal records using the application-system templates.
Submit a copy of the valid passport photo page and any China visa page.
Submit certified or notarized high-school transcripts and diploma in Chinese or English.
TOEFL 85 or IELTS 6.0, or recognized equivalent
Submit the CSCA designated elective-subject score report for the selected route.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form from the application platform.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.

Register in the BUCT system, upload all required records, pay the non-refundable CNY 500 fee after preliminary review, complete the online academic test and comprehensive interview, and monitor email/platform notices.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 20,000/year.
Budget for CNY 800/year insurance and the CNY 400/year residence-permit charge.
Published double-room accommodation is CNY 21,600/year per person at Chaoyang or Changping; the published Changping single room is CNY 25,200/year.

sources.title: Beijing University of Chemical Technology 2026 international master's programs

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid private passport and observe Chinese laws and BUCT regulations.
Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent with excellent academic standing and be under age 35.
Meet the nationality and residence rules in Ministry of Education Document No. 12 [2020].
Complete the application by June 30, 2026.
Submit a curriculum vitae, personal statement and study proposal using the BUCT system templates.
Submit the passport photo page and any China visa page.
Submit certified or notarized highest-degree credentials and complete academic transcripts in Chinese or English.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.
Obtain and upload a BUCT supervisor acceptance letter; applicants without it are not considered candidates.
TOEFL 85 or IELTS 6.0, or recognized equivalent
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate in Chinese or English.
Submit publications, patents or other academic achievements when available; the page states these receive priority consideration.
Register in the BUCT system, upload all required records, pay the non-refundable CNY 500 fee after preliminary review, complete the comprehensive interview and monitor email/platform notices.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 35,000/year.
Budget for CNY 800/year insurance and the CNY 400/year residence-permit charge.
Published double-room accommodation is CNY 21,600/year per person at Chaoyang or Changping; the published Changping single room is CNY 25,200/year.
